Garden Route Sundew

Original description

First described in 1987:

Drosera venusta Debbert, Mitt. Bot. Staatssamml. München 23: 432 (1987).

Read the original page (Biodiversity Heritage Library) · IPNI record

Range given in the IPNI record of that publication: South Africa (Cape Province).

How well the identifier knows it

Of 11 validation photos of Drosera venusta (photos the model never trained on), its top guess was right for 5. It gave a confident answer for 4 of them, and 4 of those were right.

Only 34 training photos: species with fewer than 40 are identified less reliably.

Most often mistaken for

  • Drosera natalensis (1 photo)
  • Drosera spatulata (1 photo)
  • Drosera slackii (1 photo)
